notes: Zone 3 is intentionally less safe and more broken than Thornveil and Elar'Thalas Approach.
The main route is still readable from the player camera through memory bridges, root strands, floating steps, and sparse guide shards.
This is a visual target scene, not yet live gameplay terrain/collision.
Scale, spacing and landmark hierarchy pass increased island separation, widened negative space, and added a top/readability render.
Depth, silhouette and landmark readability pass preserved spacing while making the rift, ruins, shrine, battlefield and safe camp more legible from the gameplay camera.
Playable vista transfer pass uses the Memory Wastes Vista Benchmark as the art-direction source of truth while preserving the playable island spacing, route logic and broad layout.
